title: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A kor planeswalker and lithomancer, daughter of Zendikar, compleated by Phyrexia and returned to her homeworld to remake it in Phyrexia's image through the Emeria Skyclave.

entities.name: Akiri
entities.description: A kor line-slinger who searches for Nahiri, haunted by the loss of Zareth, and leads the party into the Skyclave.

entities.name: Tazri
entities.description: A human adventurer and commander of Sea Gate's fighters who wears a halo and had a vision of the doom to come.

entities.name: Linvala
entities.description: An angel who aids the defenders, carries Tazri away from Sea Gate, and whose radiant light stuns Phyrexia's power.

entities.name: Orah
entities.description: A kor cleric in Akiri's party whose hand is infected by oil, who charges the elementals shouting for Zareth.

entities.name: Kaza
entities.description: A cheerful human wizard in Akiri's party who throws firebombs and rides a staff.

entities.name: Erem
entities.description: A kor warrior fighting beside Tazri who is dragged into a seedpod and transformed.

entities.name: Zareth San
entities.description: Akiri's lost friend, remembered for his stubbornness.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker elf who called elementals Zendikar's heart.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A Planeswalker who, with Sorin and Nahiri, once drew the Eldrazi to Zendikar.

entities.name: Sorin
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped Nahiri and Ugin millennia ago.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invading army with oil and seedpods spreading across Zendikar.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: A port city whose marble columns are overrun by Phyrexian forces and falls.

entities.name: Emeria Skyclave
entities.description: A kor ruin among floating fragments that Nahiri converts into the heart of her hedron network.

entities.name: Hedrons
entities.description: Stone constructs Nahiri made long ago to hold the Eldrazi, now repurposed to open rifts and carry Phyrexian forces.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nahiri's homeworld under Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: The Roil
entities.description: Zendikar's destructive earth-shaking turmoil that Nahiri suppresses.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Ancient cosmic horrors previously defeated on Zendikar.

entities.name: Invasion Tree
entities.description: The tree whose branches burst from portals in Zendikar's sky and sea.

entities.name: Phyrexianized elementals
entities.description: Zendikar's guardian elementals, converted into oil-covered Phyrexian zealots in the Skyclave.

entities.name: Tazeem
entities.description: A location below which the Skyclave seemed to float.

entities.name: Guum Wilds
entities.description: A wild region used in Akiri's comparison to the scattered hedrons.

events.summary: Nahiri, compleated and with blades for hands, surveys the Phyrexian invasion from a floating stone and decides to use the Emeria Skyclave to connect the hedron networks.
events.quote: the Skyclave in Emeria will be the perfect access point to connect the entire hedron networks

events.summary: Akiri's party searches for Nahiri following Tazri's vision, and Akiri spots the changed Nahiri on an isolated fragment.
events.quote: She has changed, but even from a distance, Akiri knows who it is.

events.summary: Tazri commands Sea Gate's defenders against waves of Phyrexians from the Invasion Tree's branches.
events.quote: "This is our home! We've killed false gods for it! No invader will ever claim it from us!"

events.summary: Linvala reports that the lithomancer has returned, though not as an ally.
events.quote: "She has not returned as an ally."

events.summary: Erem is speared, dragged into a seedpod and transformed, laughing mechanically, as Tazri fails to save him.
events.quote: two invaders drag him into the nearest seedpod and seal him within.

events.summary: Linvala carries Tazri away as Sea Gate falls to the Phyrexians.
events.quote: From above, Tazri watches in horror as her home is, again, consumed by creatures not from this plane.

events.summary: Nahiri smothers the Roil's attacks, reducing the landscape to bedrock.
events.quote: Eventually the earth quiets.

events.summary: Akiri tracks Nahiri, watching the Skyclave turn to white metal and more invaders arrive.
events.quote: She's witnessed the Skyclave's broken stone mend and transform into white metal.

events.summary: Linvala brings Tazri to Akiri's party, and they agree they are the only ones left to stop Nahiri.
events.quote: "We are the only ones left to stop Nahiri,"

events.summary: The party enters the Skyclave through a small uncorrupted entrance, resolved to stop Nahiri.
events.quote: "We did not defeat the Eldrazi to be destroyed by this,"

events.summary: The party kills a corrupted tree elemental, and Orah's fingers are covered in black oil.
events.quote: The tips of his fingers are covered in a sickly black oil.

events.summary: Surrounded by Phyrexianized elementals, the party is saved when Linvala's light parts the elementals and reveals a door.
events.quote: Tazri looks and sees Linvala radiating with light and charging forward.

events.summary: They barricade the door and find the carcasses of the Skyclave's creatures.
events.quote: Around them are the carcasses of every living creature that didn't survive the Phyrexian transformation.

events.summary: In flashback, Nahiri recounts converting or killing the elementals and pouring her joy, anger and grief into the hedron network until nothing is left.
events.quote: So, she channeled her pain, her grief from the betrayals, the losses, the loneliness over the millennia.

events.summary: Nahiri fuses herself into the Skyclave's heart as its keystone, pouring in her essence.
events.quote: becoming its keystone, the heart that binds her work here together.

events.summary: The party confronts Nahiri, who recognizes Akiri and smashes her thrown knife with stone.
events.quote: "Tiny elementals. Cute," Nahiri says

events.summary: Nahiri's stone attacks beat back Tazri and her friends, and it seems Zendikar is lost.
events.quote: Zendikar is lost.

events.summary: Linvala's radiance and Tazri's halo burn away oil and stun Phyrexia's power; Tazri hurls the halo at Nahiri.
events.quote: Tazri yanks the halo off from around her neck and in one desperate movement, hurls it at the entombed Planeswalker.

events.summary: The keystone breaks and Nahiri crumbles out of the stone; the Skyclave begins to collapse.
events.quote: the keystone breaks and Nahiri crumbles from her stone and metal embrace.

events.summary: Akiri leads her friends out of the collapsing Skyclave, leaping into the sky and catching a hedron with her rope.
events.quote: But Akiri is a master line-slinger and midway through their failing arc, she lets her rope fly.

events.summary: The Skyclave falls with the corrupted Planeswalker trapped inside, while the sky takes on a soft iridescent glow.
events.quote: The Emeria Skyclave is falling to the earth.

relations.note: Akiri trusts Tazri's vision and fights with her
Nahiri has haunted Akiri's dreams since Zareth's death
relations.quote: That figure, that face, has haunted her dreams since she lost Zareth.

relations.note: Tazri fights Nahiri to save Zendikar
relations.quote: "We are the only ones left to stop Nahiri,"

relations.note: Linvala carries her out and fights beside her
relations.quote: the angel wraps her arms around her and soars up into the air.

relations.note: Orah is one of Akiri's companions
relations.quote: Her companions—her friends—insisted on coming with her

relations.note: Nahiri aids the Phyrexian conquest of Zendikar
relations.quote: Far below her, the Phyrexian invasion is gaining ground.

relations.note: Nahiri created the hedron network long ago to keep the Eldrazi at bay
relations.quote: the defense she created so long ago to keep the Eldrazi at bay

relations.note: Kaza calls Akiri boss and follows her
Sea Gate is a city of Zendikar overrun by the invasion
